Class RecipeScenarios

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.gametest.RecipeScenarios
final class RecipeScenarios extends Object
Cross-loader recipe scenarios; each loader wraps every method as a GameTest.

  • Method Summary

    Modifier and Type
    Method
    Description
    (package private) static void
    all_shipped_recipe_ids_load(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
    Automation-only: resolves every shipped recipe id from the server recipe manager and requires each one to exist.
    (package private) static void
    furnace_burns_one_lava_unit_and_returns_the_big_bucket(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
    Manual: put cobblestone in a furnace and a Big Bucket holding two lava units in its fuel slot; the furnace lights and hands back the bucket with one unit.
    (package private) static void
    huge_bucket_recipe_accepts_only_empty_big_buckets(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
    Manual: craft the Huge Bucket ring with empty Big Buckets, then repeat with one filled bucket; only the empty ring matches.
    (package private) static void
    mob_bucket_recipe_accepts_empty_source_and_standard_spawn_egg(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
    Manual: shapeless-craft an empty Source Bucket with a spawn egg; a Mob Bucket is produced, but a filled source is rejected.
    (package private) static void
    source_bucket_recipe_accepts_only_empty_trash_buckets(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
    Manual: shapeless-craft the Source Bucket ingredients with an empty and then nonempty Trash Bucket; only the empty one matches.
    (package private) static void
    trash_bucket_recipe_accepts_only_empty_junk_buckets(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
    Manual: shapeless-craft the Trash Bucket ingredients with an empty and then nonempty Junk Bucket; only the empty one matches.
